HomePage.description: BNP Coorporation Sarl (BNPC), Cameroonian company based in Yaoundé since 2023: fire safety (SSIAP, ERP audits), construction, water drilling, solar, drones and naval repair. Operating from Yaoundé and Douala across Cameroon. Quote within 24-48h.

ContactPage.aboutCol1: Founded in 2023 and based in Yaoundé, BNP Coorporation Sarl is a versatile, dynamic company dedicated to providing reliable, high-quality services. We deliver tailor-made projects meeting the specific needs of our clients, whether large corporations, SMEs (B2B) or individuals (B2C) in Yaoundé, Douala and across Cameroon.
ContactPage.aboutCol2: Thanks to a dedicated team of passionate experts and strong strategic partnerships, we combine cutting-edge expertise with field mastery (industries, ports, construction) to tackle complex challenges and bring real added value to every project.
ContactPage.missionDesc: To be a trusted, preferred partner by providing high-quality services and solutions, while actively contributing to the socio-economic development of Cameroon. We are committed to delivering exceptional service and promoting innovation to build lasting relationships with our clients.
ContactPage.visionDesc: To become the leading multi-service reference partner in Cameroon and the sub-region, recognized for operational excellence, reliability and positive impact.
ContactPage.value1Desc: Top-quality deliverables and services at every stage of our projects.
ContactPage.value2Desc: Tailor-made solutions designed to meet your requirements precisely.
ContactPage.value3Desc: Strict respect for ethics and full transparency in all our interventions.
ContactPage.value4Desc: Modern technologies and methods (notably the use of drones) to meet current challenges.
ContactPage.value5Desc: Close partnership with our clients to guarantee optimal results.
ContactPage.value6Desc: An active, concrete contribution to local economic growth.

ContactPage.faqTitle: Frequently asked questions about our intervention procedures
ContactPage.faq1Q: What is the lead time for a quote at BNP Coorporation Sarl?
ContactPage.faq1A: Our engineers and technical experts analyze your request and send you a detailed proposal within 24 to 48 business hours. For industrial or naval emergencies, our teams can be mobilized immediately.
ContactPage.faq2Q: Do you operate outside Yaoundé and Douala?
ContactPage.faq2A: Yes, we cover the entire Cameroonian territory (Kribi, Garoua, Bamenda, Bafoussam, agricultural areas and isolated industrial sites).
ContactPage.faq3Q: Do you carry out on-site technical visits before pricing?
ContactPage.faq3A: Absolutely. For construction works, water boreholes, solar installations and fire safety audits, our technicians visit your site to perform an accurate diagnosis before any quote validation.
